verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA authenticator app, not an AI agent or assistant host. Acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no AI or agent features (only import/export, backups, sharing, a CLI and llms.txt), so nothing makes this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
